sentences.text: The genus name Grallistrix means 'owl on stilts' because of their long legs and terrestrial habits evolved without mammalian predators.
Scientists have never seen these owls alive; they are known only from subfossil bones.
These owls fed on smaller birds, including Hawaiian honeycreepers.
Although capable of flight, these owls likely hunted mostly on the ground to fill niches occupied by medium-sized predatory mammals.
The genus Grallistrix was described by Olson and James in 1991.
Grallistrix belongs to the family Strigidae.
The type species of the genus Grallistrix is Grallistrix auceps.
Grallistrix lived from the Late Pleistocene to the Holocene, between 0.129 and 0 million years ago.
